caption: The drawing features a single ornate object resembling an intricate key or decorative metalwork. The object is composed primarily of complex, swirling, scroll-like forms and repeated floral motifs, incorporating several small, rounded flower shapes within the design. The structure appears to be made of a metallic material, rendered in shades of grey, with subtle highlights and shadows enhancing the sense of three-dimensionality. The color palette consists mostly of muted greys and browns. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional details or objects, placing the focus entirely on the elaborate central object, which is drawn in a realistic and detailed manner. The artist's signature, "PETER CONNAN," appears in small print on the lower right side of the image.
title: Iron Holder
